part.text:
I could not open the create-room menu. This environment has no way to tap on-screen elements, and I did not use `cliclick` because the task rules out host mouse events.

- **What I tried:** I took screenshots and found the compose icon (pencil-in-square) at the bottom right of the "All chats" screen. That is the create-room entry point. I then tried the `element://create-room` deep link, which was a guess. It did not open the menu. Instead, iOS is showing an "Open in “Element Classic”?" confirmation dialog with Cancel and Open buttons.
- **Needs your action:** That dialog is a side effect of my attempt and is still on screen. Tap Cancel to dismiss it, then tap the pencil-in-square icon at the bottom right to open the create-room menu. Tapping it manually should be the only step left.
